test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 26 Oct, 2023)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4 **i.e. **gained**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** sentence describes** the recent developments in movements advocating for equality and justice.
 
• The word "**momentum**" refers to the driving force gained by the development of a process or course of events.
 
• "**Gained**" appropriately fits with "**momentum**," indicating that these movements have progressively gathered strength and support.

Therefore, the correct answer is **gained**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: invoked. **This word means to call upon something, such as a concept or authority, which does not fit the context of accumulating momentum.
 
• **Option 2: scattered**. This word means spread out over a large area, which would be inappropriate to describe gathering strength.
 
• **Option 3: provided.** While it means supplied or made available, it does not correctly convey the notion of accumulating force or support.
